Hi Rafael,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SIG review we need to validate how privileged accounts and role assignments originated in your tenant for a representative window (May 1 — Jun 1, 2025). Specifically we need: 

- SCIM delta extract for the window (create/update/delete events) including actor and timestamp.
- SAML assertion samples for at least three SSO login events for a service account and an admin user (include full assertion, timestamps redacted only where required).
- A role-to-member mapping with the owner/approver field populated and an explanation for any roles that currently have more than 5 members.
- Evidence of least-privilege checks (any automated pruning/alerting or manual review notes).

I've attached our SIG questionnaire (tab: AccessLineage) — FINWELL expects the artifacts as downloadable links or CSV exports. If you need a narrower slice, tell us which tenant IDs we should export.

Can you confirm receipt and an estimated delivery date?

Regards,
Sara Liu
